text: There are 6 cubes on the counters in this kitchen. Some of them satisfy this rule: every cube that has a triangle. Put every cube that satisfies it in the blue bin and every other cube in the yellow bin, then press Submit. Other objects on the counter are not part of the task; you may move them if needed. You act through helper actions; the helpers move objects exactly. Instead of pressing Submit, give your answer with SUBMIT.
intro: On the work counter you see white cubes 1 to 6, numbered from left to right as the left camera sees them. Each face of a cube is blank or carries one mark (a coloured shape). From where you stand you see at best the top and the two near sides of a cube; its bottom and its two far sides are turned away. The cameras show: cube 1 - top: not visible; near sides: not visible and no mark; cube 2 - top: no mark; near sides: no mark and no mark; cube 3 - top: a black cross; near sides: no mark and no mark; cube 4 - top: a black cross; near sides: no mark and no mark; cube 5 - top: not visible; near sides: no mark and not visible; cube 6 - top: no mark; near sides: no mark and no mark. A plate leans on cube 1. A plate leans on cube 5. The blue bin stands on the right and the yellow bin on the left of the counter.
help:
LIFT CUBE c - lift cube c, hold it up to the wrist camera with its bottom corner toward the camera (the bottom and the two far sides show), put it back
LOOK AT CUBE c - lift cube c, hold it up to the wrist camera with its top corner toward the camera (the top and the two near sides show), put it back
LOOK AROUND THE KITCHEN - look for the cubes the cameras do not show
SUBMIT a b - put the named cubes in the blue bin and every other cube you know in the yellow bin (your answer; SUBMIT NONE puts every cube in the yellow bin)
